# Court Marriage Help

Independent legal consultancy for court marriage and marriage registration across Delhi NCR — Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Gurugram and Faridabad.

We help with documentation assistance, consultation and appointment support for:

- Court marriage under the Special Marriage Act, 1954 (couples of any religion)
- Registration of marriages already solemnized (including under the Hindu Marriage Act)
- Interfaith court marriage guidance
- Online application assistance on official government portals (e-District Delhi, IGRS UP, e-Services Haryana)
- Court marriage documents, notice periods, jurisdiction and government process
